meta.title: Lantern House Hội An: boutique hotel near the old town
meta.description: Eighteen rooms around a lantern-lit courtyard and pool, a five-minute walk from Hội An's old town. Breakfast included, bicycles free; book by phone, Zalo or email.
meta.ogImageAlt: A yellow colonial-style hotel with silk lanterns reflected in its courtyard pool at dusk

hero.title: Come home to lantern light
hero.text: Eighteen rooms around a courtyard pool, a five-minute walk from the old town. Breakfast under the frangipani, bicycles at the gate.
hero.imageAlt: The hotel's yellow walls and silk lanterns reflected in the courtyard pool at dusk

rooms.title: Three ways to stay
rooms.intro: Every room has air conditioning, a rain shower, quality linen and a view of the garden or the pool.

garden.name: Garden Twin

deluxe.name: Deluxe King
deluxe.imageAlt: Deluxe room with a king bed, dark wood furniture and lantern lamps

suite.imageAlt: Suite with rattan armchairs and a freestanding bathtub by a large window

amenities.title: Everything for slow days
amenities.intro: Small enough to know your name, equipped like a bigger hotel.
amenities.poolAlt: The turquoise pool among palm trees and wooden sun loungers
amenities.courtyardAlt: The courtyard garden with tropical plants and hanging lanterns

items.title: Courtyard pool
items.text: Open 7:00 to 21:00, towels by the loungers.

items.title: Breakfast included
items.text: Cao lầu, bánh mì, fruit and eggs your way, served until 10:30.

items.title: Free bicycles
items.text: Ride to the old town or the rice fields; maps at reception.

items.title: Airport transfer
items.text: Private car from Đà Nẵng airport, on request (fee).

items.title: Laundry
items.text: Same-day laundry service, priced by the kilo.

location.title: On a quiet street, close to everything
location.intro: Far enough from the night market to sleep well, close enough to walk to dinner.
location.imageAlt: Hội An's old town at night under strings of colourful silk lanterns

places.oldTown: Old town and the Japanese bridge

items.title: Booking
items.text: By phone, Zalo or email. We confirm in writing with the rate, what it includes and the cancellation terms.

items.title: Cancellation
items.text: The terms depend on the season and the rate; they are stated in your confirmation before you pay anything.

items.title: Children
items.text: Children under 6 stay free in their parents' room; a baby cot is available on request.

items.title: Pets and smoking
items.text: We cannot host pets. Smoking is allowed only in the garden, away from the rooms.

items.a: Whenever a room is ready, yes. Otherwise leave your luggage with us, enjoy the pool and breakfast, and we call you when the room is ready.

items.q: How do we get from the airport?
items.a: Đà Nẵng airport is about 45 minutes by car. We can arrange a private car on request; the price is confirmed when you book.
Yes, for motorbikes and bicycles in the courtyard; for cars, a paid car park is two minutes away.
Reception books cooking classes, lantern-making workshops, basket-boat rides and trips to Mỹ Sơn with trusted local partners.
Yes, for every room and every night.

visit.title: We'll keep a lantern lit for you
visit.text: Call, message us on Zalo or email with your dates: we reply with availability and the best rate.
visit.note: Reception is open day and night.
